description: This PHP source file defines the ConnectorsController class, which manages connector-related actions within the SuiteCRM system. It includes functions for processing connector configurations, handling CRUD operations, executing tests, managing mappings, and updating metadata related to external data sources.

classes.name: ConnectorsController
classes.description: A controller class handling various connector operations such as setting search parameters, retrieving source details, running tests, saving configurations, managing mappings, and integrating social fields.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Overrides parent process, adds access control for admin actions.

methods.name: action_SetSearch
methods.description: Sets search parameters in session for a given source and module.

methods.name: action_RetrieveSourceDetails
methods.description: Retrieves and displays detailed information for a specific source record.

methods.name: action_GetSearchForm
methods.description: Generates and returns a search form for connectors.

methods.name: action_CallConnectorFunc
methods.description: Invokes a specified method on a connector source object.

methods.name: remoteFileExists
methods.description: Checks if a remote URL exists via cURL.

methods.name: action_CallSoap
methods.description: Executes a SOAP request to a connector source and returns specified fields.

methods.name: action_DefaultSoapPopup
methods.description: Retrieves and displays data in a popup for SOAP connector responses based on module record.

methods.name: action_SaveModifyProperties
methods.description: Saves modified properties for connector sources and updates metadata.

methods.name: action_SaveModifyDisplay
methods.description: Updates display configurations and synchronizes search definitions and field mappings.

methods.name: action_SaveModifyMapping
methods.description: Saves modified source-module-field mappings to files and updates internal configurations.

methods.name: action_RunTest
methods.description: Runs a connectivity test on a given source and outputs success/failure message.

methods.name: action_RetrieveSources
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of available connector sources.

methods.name: add_social_field
methods.description: Adds a social media related custom field to a module.

methods.name: create_panel_on_view
methods.description: Creates or updates a panel in the view definition for custom fields.
